BC bike rides on YouTube

Bike rides in British Columbia, filmed from the saddle and posted to YouTube. Something to pedal along to this winter, on a trainer, a spin bike, or anything with pedals. There's also a list of trip stories, for when you'd rather watch someone else do the work. Click a dot on the map, or open a list below.

579rider's-view rides
432one continuous ride
147edited
340trip stories
438creators

We found these by searching YouTube, and we haven't watched every one. Which list a video is on, and its tags, come from what each creator wrote about it.

Loading the map…

On the map#

The dot is where the video starts, as near as we could tell. Some are only placed at the town, so a dot in the middle of a city may be a few kilometres off. Videos that start at the same spot are spread in a little circle, so zoom in to see them all.

Found on YouTube on November 21, 2026.

What you're looking at#

Rider's view is for pedalling along. Each video is filmed from the saddle, so you can put one on while you ride a trainer or a spin bike and ride the seawall in January. "One continuous ride" follows a single ride from start to finish, sometimes sped up. "Edited" is cut together from the riding, with highlights, stops, or a bit of talking.

Trip stories are for watching. Someone rides a trail or tours for a few days and tells you about it, which is good for planning or for seeing what a trip is really like. We only list trips that are mostly in BC, so a cross-Canada video that spends five minutes here isn't on it, but its BC episode is.

How we found them#

We ran 386 YouTube searches on November 21, 2026: place names paired with words like "bike ride POV" and "virtual cycling", plus trail and bikepacking route names and cross-Canada trips. That turned up 5,908 videos. We kept the ones that are rides or trips mostly in BC, using AI to read each title and description. Nobody has watched all of them.

So some of the lists, tags, and places will be off. View counts are from the day we looked.

Most of the rider's-view videos are in Metro Vancouver and around Victoria. That's where people film. The Interior and the North are thin.

For creators#

Thank you for filming these. If you made one of the videos here and would rather it wasn't listed, or you've filmed a BC ride we don't have, email hello@bccycletourism.ca.

More#

For indoor rides that move with your pedalling, see BC rides on Rouvy. Other lists and data are on our Research and Data page.
